text:
nora: FYI dcgm-exporter started spamming ECC/Xid alerts in us-west2-ps yesterday evening. looks like same node, different card ids in quick succession.
ben: saw it too. alerts came in ~1m apart for different gpu_index values. noisy but short-lived.
nora: exact pattern: three ECC events across gpus 0..2 within 90s, then silence for ~30m. prom fired on our 5m rule and then again when aggregation window slid.
kai: can you paste the raw prom query you used? want to reproduce in grafana.
nora: query i used: `sum by(instance, gpu_index) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]))` returned `us-west2-ps-2:0 -> 1, :1 -> 1, :2 -> 1` at 2023-11-02T21:14Z.
ben: that's the problem: increase() on 5m is too short for these micro-bursts, causes multiple alerts while ops are still investigating the first.
oncall-bot: alert fired: GPU_ECC_HIGH (severity=warning) instance=us-west2-ps-2 gpu_index=0 value=1 ts=3367890201
sara: suggestion: move to count_over_time >= 2 over 15m, or require a per-node aggregation so single-card flicker doesn't trigger node-level paging.
kai: +1 to per-card threshold. For paging we should require either sustained errors on same card OR >1 card in same node. prevents chasing transient single-card ticks.
nora: sketching a quick rule we can test in dev:
```yaml
- alert: GPU_ECC_BURST
  expr: |
    (sum by(instance, gpu_index) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[15m])) >= 2)
    or (count by(instance) (sum by(instance, gpu_index) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[10m])) > 0) > 1)
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU ECC burst on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
ben: that looks reasonable. maybe simplify second clause: count of gpu_index with increase>0 in 10m > 1. also add a 10m for auto-resolve to avoid long-running alerts.
sara: can we also add a short suppression window for alerts that rapidly retrigger? like silence identical alert keys for 20m in alertmanager, but let new gpu_index events through.
kai: alertmanager silence would be coarse if we group by instance+gpu_index. we want to silence identical instance+gpu_index for 20m after notify. implement with `repeat_interval: 20m` on receiver + correct grouping.
oncall-bot: next steps: created a test rule in staging prometheus job `dcgm-eval` at 3367890300. Please validate.
nora: i'll run a synthetic burst generator against staging exporter to verify firing behavior. short plan: 1) push rule to staging, 2) replay recorded metric spike, 3) confirm single alert vs flurry, 4) tweak thresholds.
ben: post results here. if staging passes, we roll subset of us-west2 clusters to new rule set during off-peak.
sara: also note cost angle: noisy alerts trigger oncall mobilization and automated drains which can waste GPU-hours. reducing false positives saves $$ and reduces churn.
kai: agreed. i'd also like a followup to add a per-card ephemeral health score to telemetry so we can do rolling averages instead of raw counts.
nora: thanks team. i'll update the PR with the 15m rule and the alertmanager repeat_interval suggestion. tagging @sre for visibility when we rollout to prod. :thumbsup:
